rationale: Affected baseline: 25 of 88 items. Reconciliation: 88 reconciled, 88 unique, zero duplicate keys, with all 88 labeled normalized_match/mismatch. The packet's low_confidence outcome is sustained because the restaurant menu cannot verify complete allergen arrays or cross-contact. Terra correctly identified the disclosure gap and catalog drift, but overstates several deterministic gates and incompletely reports current-only products. Explicit restaurant-issued positives must be preserved, and Firnee presents a concrete milk omission in the baseline.
